verdict.rationale: Docs confirm traces capture all LLM and non-LLM calls (implying nested spans/observations), native support for multi-turn conversations as sessions/user tracking, and agent graph visualization for complex multi-step workflows; community testimonials corroborate strong tracing capability for debugging complex LLM pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit terminology/documentation of 'nested span' hierarchy depth and 'thread' grouping, plus a hands-on independent example of a multi-step agent trace visualized as nested spans.
